title: Inner product of Gaussian correlation images
statement: For every real number $\rho$, every pair $(u,v)\in\mathbb{R}^2$, and every vector $t$ in the real correlation plane, the inner product of the Gaussian correlation image of $(u,v)$ with $t$ is $u$ times the sum of the first coordinate of $t$ and $\rho$ times its second coordinate, plus $v$ times $\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$ times the second coordinate of $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ belongs to the real correlation plane
